unlisted_practices: Validating an LLM-based criterion extractor against a blind three-rater human gold standard and a human-annotated corpus
Measuring the logical (disjunctive) structure of eligibility criteria before choosing a trial-matching or coverage metric

screen.reason: The study validates an LLM-based information extraction tool to analyze the Boolean logical structure (disjunctions) of clinical trial eligibility criteria across a large corpus, highlighting implications for automated trial-matching algorithms.
